import * as z from "zod"

export const Agent = z.object({
  description: z.string(),
  id: z.nanoid({ length: 6 }).regex(/^[A-Za-z0-9]+$/),
  name: z.string().regex(/^[a-z]+$/),
})

export type Agent = z.infer<typeof Agent>
